title: A Archive for the Machine
author: Wren Okafor
blurb: Beatrix Ishikawa, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
